hours.weekday: Residents: 24 hours. Staff and security on duty 24 hours.
hours.notes: Doors open with a personal key; building entry with the student card. No guests are accepted; no pets; no separate guest house; only IEU students may stay. Breakfast is included; lunch and dinner are paid in campus restaurants. No entry/exit curfew is stated in the bylaw or FAQ. Opening/closing dates are set by the Yurt Yonetim Kurulu in line with the academic calendar. The latest published dorm calendar is 2025-2026 (undergraduate: move-in 20-21 Sep 2025, classes 22 Sep; vacate 14 Jan-14 Feb 2026; move-in again 14-15 Feb 2026; vacate 15-16 Jun 2026; holidays may be spent in the dorm). The 2026-2027 dorm calendar is not yet published there. Summer school/internship stays are possible within quota.

facts.fact: Official name İzmir Ekonomi Üniversitesi (İEÜ); Balçova campus address Sakarya Caddesi No:156, 35330 Balçova, İzmir. Tender documents write the address as 'Fevzi Çakmak Mahallesi, Sakarya Cad. No:156'. The ECTS page says the campus lies in Balçova at the 'Teleferik mevkii'.
Founded by law no. 4633, published in the Resmi Gazete no. 24373 on 14 April 2001, as 2 faculties, 5 schools (yüksekokul) and 2 institutes.

Founding body: İzmir Ticaret Odası Eğitim ve Sağlık Vakfı. History given by IEU: the İzmir Chamber of Commerce (İZTO) was founded in 1885; it set up the İzmir Ticaret Odası Sosyal Yardımlaşma Vakfı in 1988; the foundation became 'İzmir Ticaret Odası Eğitim ve Sağlık Vakfı' in 1995; the university followed in 2001.
The university moved to its present Balçova campus on 1 July 2001 and started with 288 students.

Claim: 'Ege Bölgesi'nin ilk vakıf üniversitesi' (the first foundation university of the Aegean Region). Repeated in the 25th-anniversary message: 'Ege Bölgesi'nin ilk vakıf üniversitesi olarak, 14 Nisan 2001 tarihinde başladığımız eğitim yolculuğu'.

Numbers in the 25th-anniversary message (2026): about 28 thousand alumni, 12 thousand students, one thousand academics and 300 administrative staff (rounded figures from a speech, not an official statistic).

Structure stated on the history page: 8 faculties, 2 schools (yüksekokul), 3 vocational schools (MYO) and the graduate institute. Faculty of Medicine: started 2017-2018 with 60 students, 283 students now and 138 graduates (dean's message on the 25th-year site).

Slogan: 'bilimle anla bilgiyle yönet' (English version in the logo guide: 'Comprehend with science, manage with knowledge'). The wordmark reads İZMİR EKONOMİ ÜNİVERSİTESİ, with the slogan below it in the recommended version.

Corporate colours (logo guide, 2020): primary orange Pantone 1505 (CMYK 0/64/100/0, RGB 255/105/0, HEX FF6900) and black; complementary Pantone Cool Gray 10 (RGB 99/102/106, HEX 63666A) and Pantone 2768 dark navy (RGB 7/29/73, HEX 071D49); metallic gold Pantone 871 and metallic silver Pantone 877. The guide prints HEX 878786 next to the black swatch although its RGB is 0/0/0 (inconsistent in the source).

Typography (logo guide): logotype in Eurostile Extended; Helvetica is the primary publication font, with Open Sans as the only allowed substitute. Logo on dark backgrounds is used in white (negative), on light backgrounds in the original colours; minimum logo size 12 mm; a separate KAMPÜSİZMİR logo exists.

The university emblem is an orange rounded symbol with a white figure placed next to the wordmark (seen on the header of the rendered tender site sketch; an observation of the image, not a text statement).
2026 is the university's 25th anniversary ('25. YIL' site); the second campus (Güzelbahçe) is announced in the same period and is separate from the Balçova campus.

Official 'İEÜ'de Hayat' text: the campus is 'eğlenceli, dinamik ve 24 saat yaşayan' (fun, dynamic, living 24 hours); Alsancak or Konak is about 25 minutes away; the campus sits at the foot of a forest ('sırtını ormana yaslayıp denizi seyredebilirsin'); nearby attractions named are Balçova Terapi Ormanı (walking and sport), the Tarihi Asansör and the cable car (Teleferik).
Official text mentions 'ünlü isimlerin katılımıyla gerçekleşen söyleşiler, sürpriz konserler, sıra dışı etkinlik ve şenlikler' (talks with well-known guests, surprise concerts, festivals) on campus.

Accessibility: the campus was built to ease access for people with orthopaedic disabilities; the Engelli Öğrenci Destek Birimi sits in the Sağlık, Kültür ve Spor Müdürlüğü; each dorm building has a ground-floor 4-person disabled room.
Smart Campus: students can join lectures live online and re-watch lecture recordings.

Sports teams listed by the Spor Koordinatörlüğü (18): men's basketball, women's basketball, women's volleyball, men's football, men's tennis, women's tennis, fencing, sailing, swimming, taekwondo, American football (korumalı futbol), chess, 3x3 men's basketball, 3x3 women's basketball, beach volleyball, shooting, men's e-sports, women's e-sports. The IEU Spor Kulübü was founded in 2005 (ECTS page).

Sports events named by the coordinator: nature walks, yoga, zumba, bodyfit, table-tennis tournaments (students and staff), staff volleyball team, chess tournament, 3x3 student basketball tournament, foosball tournament, Sports Awards Gala.

Card access system (EkoKart, project started 2007): about 7000 users; 13 turnstiles at 3 main entrance points; vehicle barriers at 3 points (2 integrated); GSTF building has 15 card-controlled doors. Staff meal rights are used with the card on POS terminals at restaurants, cafeterias and canteens, valid for the same day only (no carry-over, no vouchers).

Student ID card: needed to enter the campus, shown in class when asked and mandatory at exams; the sticker is renewed each academic year; also used for on-campus payments (parking, photocopy, document requests) and for discounts on city buses, metro and ferries.

Tobacco and e-cigarettes are banned in areas the university is responsible for (tender specification for the cafeteria); smoking is also banned in the Amfitiyatro during ceremonies. The university follows the Ministry of Health 'Beslenme Dostu ve Fiziksel Aktiviteyi Destekleyen İş Yeri Programı' (2021) and calls itself a 'Sağlıklı Kampüs'.

Named event venues in official texts: Amfitiyatro / Amfi Tiyatro (open-air, hosts graduation and festival concerts), Konferans Salonu and A Blok Fuaye Alanı (Career Days), A Blok Konferans Salonu, D Blok Çok Amaçlı Salon, D blok konferans salonu, M Blok kantin, M blok ana giriş, A Blok Kantin Alanı, Tören Alanı, Koru Alanı.
PGDM (psychology center) is in A Blok, floor -1, offices 1B18 and 1B19. The A Block also houses the conference hall and its foyer.

Dorms opened in 2006 inside the campus; capacity 474 (282 girls, 192 boys); geothermal heating and hot water, central air conditioning; 24-hour staff and security; DEU Hospital is near, and the campus is close to Carrefoursa, Migros, Agora, Palmiye, Ege Park and İstinye Park shopping centres.

Campus food on the official 'Kafe ve Restoran' page is only a photo gallery; the ECTS info package says the campus has a restaurant and a main cafeteria (students need a voucher) and a cafeteria inside the dorm.

Ağaçaltı cafeteria tender specification: the operator must upload the final menu list to a university web site daily or monthly, and must serve every day, for staff and students, at least one lunch menu priced at the university's staff-card daily meal amount.
